content.text: {"vat": "London Bridge, a long bridge lined with houses and seen from across the Thames", "dac_diem": "A long, dense row of tall, narrow, brown-walled buildings runs diagonally out into the river on a stone embankment or piers. Pale domed or cupola turrets stand on top, and a tall-masted sailing ship lies beside it. The river is in front. Timber-framed houses with red and grey roofs and chimneys fill the foreground and the far bank. Many pale spires or towers rise in the hazy distance.", "co_tu_nam": 1209, "da_co_nam_1666": "yes", "ly_do": "The stone London Bridge was completed in 1209, and by the 1600s it carried rows of houses. It still stood in 1666 and was partly burned in the Great Fire. The timber-framed houses and sailing ship also fit the period."}
